tours.overview: An intimate photography workshop deep in the Sundarbans, the world's largest mangrove delta and home to the Royal Bengal Tiger. Limited to 9 participants to ensure personal mentorship and minimal wildlife disturbance.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Orientation
itinerary.description: Arrive at Godkhali jetty by afternoon. Board our private launch, settle into the forest lodge, and attend an evening briefing on tiger behaviour and camera settings for low-light forest conditions.

itinerary.title: Dawn Boat Safari
itinerary.description: Pre-dawn departure into the core zone. Photograph tigers, spotted deer, and estuarine crocodiles in the golden morning light. Afternoon workshop on editing and composition critique.

itinerary.title: Watchtower & Mangrove Walk
itinerary.description: Early watchtower vigil for tiger sightings at a watering hole. Guided mangrove walk to photograph kingfishers, sea eagles, and the extraordinary root systems. Evening one-on-one review session.

itinerary.title: Final Safari & Departure
itinerary.description: Last morning boat safari at sunrise, followed by a group image-sharing session. Return to Kolkata by afternoon. Take home edited images and a personalised feedback document.

tours.accommodation: Forest lodge with en-suite rooms overlooking the creek. Solar-powered, with a viewing deck and quiet common areas for reviewing images.
tours.meals: All meals included — traditional Bengali cuisine prepared fresh each day. Packed breakfast on early safari mornings. Special dietary requirements accommodated on request.
tours.transportation: Private AC vehicle from Kolkata to Godkhali (approx. 2.5 hrs), then private launch through the delta to the lodge. All safari movement is by dedicated boat.
thingsToCarry: DSLR or mirrorless camera with telephoto lens (minimum 300mm recommended)
Light full-sleeve clothing in earth tones (no bright colours)
A small backpack for day gear
importantNotes: Pickup from Kolkata city centre can be arranged for an additional charge.
The forest is a protected zone — strictly no plastic bags or single-use plastics.
Sightings are never guaranteed; the Sundarbans rewards patience and silence.
Minimum age for participants is 14 years.
Seats are confirmed only upon receipt of advance payment.
Tour operates rain or shine — the monsoon edge light is exceptional for photography.

bookingInfo.cancellationPolicy: Full refund up to 30 days before start. 50% refund between 15–30 days. No refund within 14 days.
